name: context-optimizer
description: Automatically expands vague queries into professionally optimized prompts using a 6-stage reasoning pipeline

interface.shortDescription: Expand vague queries into pro-grade prompts
interface.longDescription: Works like an always-on prompt engineer. Every query is analyzed through 6 stages: ambiguity classification, gap audit, assumption inventory, alternative interpretations, query reconstruction, and presentation. Shows the user what changed before answering.
